summary: Backend regression test after base64-encoding the Shopify client secret fallback. All 5 target endpoints pass: /api/catalog/home (6 featured products with real hero images), /api/catalog/products (53 products with numeric variant_id), /api/shopify/readiness (connection_ready=true), /api/checkout (returns Shopify cart permalink), and CORS with royalsparkjewelry.com Origin returns correct ACAO header. Confirms the base64 change did NOT break Shopify token auto-refresh or catalog fetching.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores DEFAULT_SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET as base64 to bypass GitHub push protection. This is obfuscation, not security - the secret is still committed to git in decodable form. Recommend rotating the Shopify client secret and moving it exclusively to environment variables (SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET) with no code fallback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_shopify_regression.py verifies Shopify token flow end-to-end. All 5 endpoints healthy. Products endpoint returns {items,total,categories} shape. Some hero_image URLs may still be /product-placeholder.png for non-featured products but featured products have real Shopify CDN URLs.
